23/S0.subgoal: Explain the concept of 'disappearing technology' and its relation to the perception of presence.

23/S1.subgoal: Describe the historical progression of computing devices towards ubiquitous and interactive systems.

23/S2.subgoal: Define interactive systems and clarify the necessary focus on the layperson user.

23/S3.subgoal: Illustrate the potential negative impacts of using technical jargon in system interfaces.

23/S4.subgoal: Explain the principles and characteristics of the user-centric design approach.

23/S5.subgoal: Define Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and understand the scope of the discipline.

23/S6.subgoal: Illustrate the importance of human factors by comparing the needs of different user types.

23/S7.subgoal: Summarize the key concerns of design in interactive systems: understanding and utilizing user knowledge.
